meta.name: aesthetic
meta.description: Create aesthetically beautiful interfaces following proven design principles. Use when building UI/UX, analyzing designs from inspiration sites, generating design images with ai-multimodal, implementing visual hierarchy and color theory, adding micro-interactions, or creating design documentation. Includes workflows for capturing and analyzing inspiration screenshots with chrome-devtools and ai-multimodal, iterative design image generation until aesthetic standards are met, and comprehensive design system guidance covering BEAUTIFUL (aesthetic principles), RIGHT (functionality/accessibility), SATISFYING (micro-interactions), and PEAK (storytelling) stages. Integrates with chrome-devtools, ai-multimodal, media-processing, ui-styling, and web-frameworks skills.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 运用设计原则打造美观的界面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要创建符合美学标准的用户界面
copy.tagline_en: Create beautiful interfaces using proven design principles
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create aesthetically pleasing user interfaces

howto.what: Claude 会按照四阶段框架（美观、正确、满意、巅峰）帮你设计界面：先分析灵感截图提取设计规范，再迭代生成设计图直到评分≥7/10，最后产出设计文档。
howto.when: 当你需要设计或分析用户界面、从灵感网站（如 Dribbble、Mobbin 等）提取设计规范、生成设计图并评估美感、或创建设计文档时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这张 Dribbble 截图，提取配色和字体。
生成一个极简风格的登录页面设计图，评分要≥7。
say.note: Claude 会迭代生成并评估，直到达标。

say.text: 为我的项目创建设计指南文档。
say.note: Claude 会使用模板生成设计指南。

howto.what_en: Claude follows a four-stage framework (BEAUTIFUL, RIGHT, SATISFYING, PEAK) to design interfaces: analyze inspiration screenshots to extract design specs, iteratively generate design images until score ≥7/10, and produce design documentation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to design or analyze UI, extract design specs from inspiration sites (e.g., Dribbble, Mobbin), generate and evaluate design images, or create design documentation.

say_en.text: Analyze this Dribbble screenshot and extract colors and fonts.
say_en.note: Claude uses chrome-devtools and ai-multimodal to analyze.

say_en.text: Generate a minimalist login page design with score ≥7.
say_en.note: Claude iterates generation and evaluation until passing.

say_en.text: Create a design guideline document for my project.
say_en.note: Claude uses templates to produce the document.
